summary: Tested incremental project file feature on preview (backend + UI). Verified create flow file picker operations (multi-add, dedupe, remove, local download bytes/name), successful project+files save and files-tab navigation persistence, partial-failure handling (415 in mixed batch) with warning and later replacement upload, edit behavior (no file picker), dashboard add-project picker, responsive save reachability (390/320), and protected download/storage-path API protections.

integration_issues.flow: Open existing inline attachment in new window
integration_issues.issue: Automation could not consistently capture a newly opened tab/window for image open action (timeout while waiting for page event), so open-behavior verification is inconclusive in this run.

action_items: Optional: add deterministic test hook for inline file open behavior (e.g., explicit indicator/event) to make automation robust for open-attachment verification.
Optional: address repeated Clerk structural CSS warning to reduce future UI fragility risk.
critical_code_review_comments: Project create flow correctly uploads each file independently and preserves project on per-file failure, matching requested behavior.
Backend file APIs correctly enforce auth and hide storage_path from response payloads.
Frontend/API configuration still uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL; no hardcoded API base URL found in reviewed feature files.
seed_data_creation: Created temporary TEST_ProjectFiles_* projects/files during UI/API testing and deleted created test projects at end of runs.

main_agent_followup.verified: Clicked real PNG attachment, captured popup, confirmed blob protocol and decoded 192x192 image, original Files tab remains selected. Temporary project cleaned up (200). No product code change needed; use a URL predicate or DOM assertion, not glob blob:* (single * does not match slashes).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary feature flows passed on preview with real uploads (TXT/PNG/PDF) and real 415 rejection for invalid-content.pdf. One verification remains inconclusive: capturing open-attachment new-window behavior in automation timed out despite other file actions passing. Cleanup attempted for all created project IDs from executed runs.
rca of the issue: Inconclusive open-attachment verification likely due popup/new-page event timing in automation context rather than confirmed product failure. Repro in automation: click [data-testid^='open-attachment-'] on image row and wait for context page event; sometimes no event captured within timeout. Mitigation: instrument open action with deterministic UI state or fallback assertion (e.g., blob URL assignment or window.open invocation counter) for reliable testability.
